title: A mixed outside batch exits non-zero and its doctor checks the target root
body:
Astra audit C4/C5 (verified): krn lane run --ready (src/cli/lane-run/drain.ts:125-146) returns the last task's exit, so a batch [74, 0] exits 0; its doctor call (drain.ts:82-85) drops --root, so doctor-unattended checks process.cwd() instead of the target repository.
Files: src/cli/lane-run/drain.ts, test/cli/outside-batch.test.ts
Outcome: a mixed batch exits non-zero and names every failed task; the batch doctor receives --root; the test exits 0 and fails on the old drain.
Proof: node --test test/cli/outside-batch.test.ts passes with a [74, 0] batch and a --root assertion.
